title.zh-TW: 漢堡選單變 × 與全螢幕選單

summary.zh-TW: 按漢堡按鈕：三條線變成 ×，藍色選單從上往下展開，選項一個一個從遮罩下方升起。關閉時把同一條時間軸倒著播，Esc 也能關。
summary.en: Press the hamburger: three lines become ×, a blue menu unfolds from the top and items rise one by one from a mask. Closing plays the same timeline in reverse; Esc works too.

text.zh-TW: 打開和關閉用同一條時間軸：打開正著播、關閉倒著播。只要寫一次動畫，兩個方向都會對。
text.en: One timeline for both directions: play to open, reverse to close. Write the animation once and both directions match.

text.zh-TW: 倒著播時加快 1.6 倍：關閉比打開快，使用者想離開時不用等。
text.en: Reverse at 1.6× speed: closing is faster than opening, so leaving never feels slow.

text.zh-TW: 上下兩條線先移到中間再各轉 45°，中間那條縮掉，就變成 ×。三條線的間距決定 y 要移多少。
text.en: The top and bottom lines move to the middle and rotate 45°, while the middle one shrinks away — that’s the ×. The line spacing decides how far y moves.

text.zh-TW: 選單用 clip-path 從上面一條線展開成整個畫面，內容本身不會被壓扁或變形。
text.en: The menu unfolds from a line at the top with clip-path, so its content never squashes or stretches.

text.zh-TW: 倒著播完才把選單藏起來（hidden），讀屏軟體和 Tab 鍵才不會跑進看不到的選單。
text.en: The menu is hidden only after reversing completes, so screen readers and Tab never land in an invisible menu.
